justifications.reuse: run_documentation_gate_checks calls the existing owner docs_gates.score_documentation rather than reimplementing gate evaluation; a search of the repository for other converters of gate outcomes to findings and for PhysicsContext construction found only docs_holdout_eval._physics_context_for (imas_codex/standard_names/docs_holdout_eval.py:164), which takes a DocsHoldoutRow with declared_unit/dd_path keys rather than an audit name row with unit/cocos_transformation_type, so it is not the same capability and no owner for this conversion exists.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff against eeed04f25 touches exactly imas_codex/standard_names/review/audits.py, imas_codex/standard_names/docs_gates.py, tests/standard_names/test_house_style_checks.py and the fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
